hypothesis.primary: Five from-scratch fixed LinUCB members aggregated by unweighted mean score, without member or seed selection, reduce path variance enough that the full ensemble and at least four of five leave-one-member-out ensembles exceed both no-trade and the best frozen RULE/random baseline at 0.23% on the reused validation screen.
hypothesis.null: The full ensemble or jackknife stability gate does not meet the frozen criterion net of 0.23% cost.
hypothesis.reused_validation_limitation: 2024-01-01 through 2025-06-30 has already been observed in M1-M3 and is a reused screening window, not fresh confirmatory evidence.

algorithm.action: select 0 to 10 distinct symbols with mean_score > 0; descending mean_score then ascending symbol tie-break

controls.control_fail_rule: any shuffled ensemble NAV > max(60000000, exposure_matched_mean + 2*std) => NO_GO

validation_gate.eligible: full ensemble and at least 4 of 5 jackknives exceed no-trade and best frozen baseline at 0.23%
validation_gate.inconclusive: full ensemble passes and 1 to 3 jackknives pass
validation_gate.no_go: negative control fails, full ensemble fails, or zero jackknives pass

forbidden_claims: paper-forward, live, broker, or order readiness
